source_column: I intend to adopt an AI-based system in my business/work because it can improve my business performance and results.
I use AI-based technology to help analyze data or information in my work or business.
The application of AI technology helps improve the efficiency of my work processes or business operations.
I believe that AI systems can provide reliable results or recommendations in my work.
The use of AI technology aligns with the needs and working methods of my business or work.
I have good skills in using various digital technologies to support my work/business.
I am able to utilize digital technologies (such as software, online platforms, or data systems) to support my work or business activities.
I have the ability to manage and utilize digital information or data to support work decision-making.
I am able to use various digital technologies to improve the efficiency of work processes or business operations.
I can integrate digital technology with my work processes or business strategies.
I am able to utilize digital technology to create or develop new ideas, products, or services in my work or business.
I have the ability to combine digital technology with organizational resources to improve work or business performance.
I have skills in using digital technology to communicate and collaborate with colleagues or business partners.
I always set clear goals before making strategic decisions in my work or business.
Before making a strategic decision, I gather information from various relevant sources (both internal and external).
I systematically evaluate several alternative solutions before making a final decision.
In making strategic decisions, I consider the potential risks and the chances of success of each alternative.
My strategic decisions are based on logical and structured analysis, not just intuition.
Before making strategic decisions, I set measurable and specific decision objectives as a basis for evaluation.
I evaluate strategic decision alternatives by quantitatively considering the probability of risks and their business consequences.
The strategic decisions I make are based on relevant data and analysis, not just personal intuition.
I make optimal use of the knowledge and information available within the organization before making strategic decisions.
In the strategic decision-making process, I encourage team participation to improve the quality of alternative evaluations.
I re-evaluate previous strategic decisions to improve the quality of subsequent decisions.
Every strategic decision I make is aligned with the company's long-term strategy and business objectives.
